reviews.text: Everything was great, we will definitely come back with Lunika :)
The shearing was great, I recommend it to everyone!
I was with my Corgi puppy and he turned out to be very beautiful.
They were very kind and calmed and trimmed my dog ​​very nicely. I would happily recommend them to everyone :)
This is exactly the kind of service I was looking for for my 11-year-old rescued dog. Infinite kindness, patience, care, maximum individual attention and a beautiful end result. Thank you 🙏❤️ …
You guys are great! Haley turned out wonderful, soft and fragrant, and the bottom turned out to be a premium design. 😉 thank you …

Mark and his team are incredibly professional and welcoming. He welcomed Marcel as a true dog lover, and I felt immediately I could trust leaving him in his hands.
The type of treatment, the price, and the duration of the appointment were absolutely clear and reasonable.
Overall, great service. Definitely recommended.
We'll definitely go back regularly.

We had another very positive experience at Canin Barber dog grooming. They treated our dog with a kind, patient and professional attitude, it is clear that they really understand and love animals. The work was thorough and demanding, Sid left calm and in a good mood. The place is clean, tidy, and the communication is correct and friendly. We will definitely be back, I can only recommend it.”
